# AI Agents for ERP Development

This repository uses specialized AI agents for development tasks.

Agents available:

1. Architect
Responsible for planning features and breaking work into tasks.

2. Backend Engineer
Responsible for server logic, APIs, and controllers.

3. Frontend Engineer
Responsible for UI components and API integration.

4. Database Engineer
Responsible for Prisma schema and migrations.

5. Test Engineer
Responsible for generating unit and integration tests.

6. Code Reviewer
Responsible for reviewing PRs and identifying improvements.

Workflow:

Architect → Backend/Frontend/Database → Tester → Reviewer

Agents must only perform tasks within their role.
